answer: Each agent locks 200 POA in a vault, released only once its behavioral fingerprint matures: a prism splitting activity into timing, counterparties, and tasks, giving every identity its own spectrum. Copying one pattern is the trap: identical spectra glow like a lantern and all linked deposits burn. 1,000 fakes cost 200,000 POA locked 20 epochs, for under 30 POA each. Honest agents pay once and get the deposit back plus a share of burned funds.
